capital.evidence_quote: Vatican City is an independent city-state entirely surrounded by Rome, Italy

currency.evidence_quote: The Euro (EUR) is the official currency under monetary agreement with the European Union

timezone.evidence_quote: Vatican City follows Central European Time UTC+1 with daylight saving UTC+2

sources.title: Governatorato dello Stato della Città del Vaticano

voltage.evidence_quote: Electrical power is synchronized with the Italian power grid at 230V 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Wall outlets accept standard European Type C, Schuko Type F, and Italian Type L three-in-line pin plugs

police.evidence_quote: St. Peter's Square is policed in coordination with Italian Polizia via 112; Gendarmerie is +39 06 698 112

sources.title: Direzione di Sanità ed Igiene Vaticano

ambulance.evidence_quote: Emergency medical dispatch is connected through Italy's 118 and Vatican Health Services

sources.title: Corpo dei Vigili del Fuoco del Vaticano

fire.evidence_quote: Emergency fire and rescue is handled via 115 or Vatican Fire Corps +39 06 698 83444

sources.title: Governatorato dello Stato della Città del Vaticano

general.evidence_quote: 112 is the European emergency number operational throughout the enclave

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Pilgrim and tourist information office operates at St. Peter's Square: +39 06 6988 1662

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Vatikan son derece güvenlidir; Aziz Petrus Meydanı ve Müzelerdeki yoğun kalabalıklarda yankesicilik riskine karşı dikkatli olunmalıdır.
advisory_headline.en: Vatican City is extremely safe; be mindful of pickpockets in crowded tourist lines at St. Peter's Square.
advisory_headline.de: Die Vatikanstadt ist überaus sicher; achten Sie auf Taschendiebe in Warteschlangen am Petersplatz.
advisory_headline.ru: Ватикан исключительно безопасен; остерегайтесь карманных краж в толпе у собора Святого Петра.
advisory_headline.es: La Ciudad del Vaticano es sumamente segura; preste atención a los carteristas en las filas de la Plaza de San Pedro.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Mobile connectivity is provided by Rome base stations with median download speeds of 95.0 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Broadband speeds in central Rome surrounding the Vatican exceed 120.0 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: There is no passport control or border fence between Italy and Vatican City. Any Italian or EU-roaming eSIM (TIM, Vodafone, WindTre, Iliad) works seamlessly across the Vatican enclave.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: The Vatican maintains an open border with Italy with no passport checks for entry into St. Peter's Square

religion.value: Roman Catholicism (100% official religion; spiritual and administrative seat of the Catholic Church)
religion.evidence_quote: Vatican City is an ecclesiastical state ruled by the Bishop of Rome (the Pope)

festivals.value: Easter Urbi et Orbi Papal Blessing, Christmas Midnight Mass, Papal General Audiences on Wednesdays
festivals.evidence_quote: Major spiritual gatherings include Easter and Christmas Papal blessings in St. Peter's Square

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Strict modesty dress code enforced at St. Peter's Basilica and Vatican Museums: shoulders and knees must be completely covered for all visitors (no sleeveless shirts, tank tops, or short skirts). Photography and speaking above a whisper are strictly forbidden inside the Sistine Chapel.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: Entry is permitted only to visitors dressed decorously with shoulders and knees covered

tipping.value: Tipping is not expected inside Vatican souvenir shops, post offices, or cafeteria services. In surrounding Rome restaurants, rounding up or leaving 5-10% is polite.

sources.title: Governatorato dello Stato della Città del Vaticano

tipping.evidence_quote: Services within the territory operate under fixed official public tariffs without tipping
